sources.snippet: Muon for embedding-model training A reproducible study of AdamW, Muon, and NorMuon for supervised fine-tuning of DenseOn-unsupervised and LateOn-unsupervised. The repository builds one shared 500,000-query training set, runs 24 controlled training jobs, evaluates five checkpoints from every job on 14 pinned decontaminated BEIR datasets, and produces publication-ready tables and plots.
